data.long_meaning: Antika refers to the ancient or timeless in Hindu mythology. It is derived from the Sanskrit word 'antikah', which means 'ancient' or 'timeless'. This name is often given to girls born into families with a rich cultural heritage, as it is believed to symbolize the enduring nature of their lineage and traditions. The name Antika carries the meaning “Ancient, Timeless” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Antika usually hope their child will grow to embody ancient, timeless and live with faith, good character and purpose.
